title: Introduction and overview — Kirov-class Battlecruiser
description: Introduction and overview of the Kirov-class Battlecruiser: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Soviet Kirov class — four nuclear-powered battlecruisers, the largest surface combatants built since WWII at 28,000 tons — carry 20 P-700 Granit anti-ship missiles plus layered air defenses. Pyotr Velikiy remains Russia's flagship; Admiral Nakhimov underwent a massive refit. They were designed to kill carrier groups. Baseline facts: Soviet nuclear battlecruiser; 4 built; 28,000 tons; 20 P-700 missiles; carrier-killer..
